entry.name: patcher
entry.digest: Create a subpatch within a patch

arguments.name: subpatch
arguments.description: The subpatch can be given a name by the argument, so that its name appears in the title bar of the subpatch window. The name in the title bar of the subpatch window is displayed in brackets to indicate that it is part of another file. If there is no argument typed in, the subpatch window is named [sub patch]. Different patcher objects that share the same name are still distinct subpatches, and do not share the same contents.

attributes.name: accentcolor
attributes.description: Sets the default accented background color for objects.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: assistshowspatchername
attributes.description: If set to 0 (default) and an inlet or outlet object in the subpatcher has a comment, the patcher name is not shown. If there is no comment, it is shown. If the attribute is set to 1, the patcher name is always shown whether or not the inlet / outlet object has a comment.

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: bgcolor
attributes.description: Sets the default background color for objects.

attributes.name: bgfillcolor
attributes.description: Sets the default gradient fill for objects.

attributes.name: bottomtoolbarpinned
attributes.description: Controls the display of the bottom toolbar when a file is opened. If set to "last saved", the toolbar will be shown only if it was visible when the patcher was saved. If set to "pin", the bottom toolbar will always be visible. If set to "unpin" the toolbar will always be invisible until the cursor moves over the bottom edge of the window.

choices.label: The bottom toolbar will be shown only if it was visible when the patcher was saved.
The bottom toolbar will always be visible.
The bottom toolbar will always be invisible until the cursor moves over the bottom edge of the window.

attributes.name: boxanimatetime
attributes.description: Sets the time, in milliseconds, used for animation of object behavior in the patcher window.

attributes.name: bubble_bgcolor
attributes.description: Sets the default background color for the comment object in bubble mode

attributes.name: bubble_outlinecolor
attributes.description: Sets the default outline color for the comment object in bubble mode

attributes.name: clearcolor
attributes.description: Sets the default background color for comment objects.

attributes.name: cluebar
attributes.description: Override the clue bar preference for this patcher

choices.digest: Use the current preference for showing the clue bar
Always show the clue bar for this patcher
Never show the clue bar for this patcher

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Sets the default foreground color for objects.

attributes.name: defaultfocusbox
attributes.description: The scripting name of the object that will receive keyboard focus when the patcher is first opened.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Sets a searchable description used by the database and documentation system.

attributes.name: digest
attributes.description: Sets a searchable short description used by the database and documentation system.

attributes.name: editing_bgcolor
attributes.description: Sets the patcher background color when the patcher is unlocked.

attributes.name: elementcolor
attributes.description: Sets the default border color for objects.

attributes.name: enablehscroll
attributes.description: If enabled, the horizontal scrollbar will appear when the patcher’s content width exceeds its window width.

attributes.name: enabletransparentbgwithtitlebar
attributes.digest: Enable Transparent Patcher With Title Bar
attributes.description: When set to 1, this enables patchers with locked and unlocked backgrounds set to 0% opacity to become fully transparent. Please note that you must change the opacity setting for the Locked Patcher Background Color,, and Unlocked Patcher Background Color,.

attributes.name: enablevscroll
attributes.description: If enabled, the vertical scrollbar will appear when the patcher’s content height exceeds its window height.

attributes.name: external_mpe_tuning_enabled
attributes.description: If enabled, Live will send tuned MPE data to the device, using per-note pitch bend messages to play in tune with the currently selected tuning system in Live. Only has an effect if the is_mpe attribute is set to 1. (The alternative approach to using Live tunings is to use Live's TuningSystem API. See the bundled Global.TuningSystem snippet for an example.)

attributes.name: filepath
attributes.description: The patcher’s complete file location if saved (read-only).

attributes.name: fontface
attributes.description: The default font style used for new text objects.

choices.label: Regular font
Bold font
Italic font
Bold and italic font

attributes.name: fontname
attributes.description: Sets the default font used for new text objects.

attributes.name: fontsize
attributes.description: Sets the default font size used for new text objects.

attributes.name: globalpatchername
attributes.description: Sets the global name by which this patcher can be referred to by pattr objects (for more information, see theobject).

attributes.name: gridonopen
attributes.description: If enabled, a grid will be displayed in the unlocked patcher background when the patcher is opened.

attributes.name: gridsize
attributes.description: Sets the X and Y size of the grid in pixels.

attributes.name: gridsnaponopen
attributes.description: If enabled, "Snap to Grid" will be on when the patcher is opened.

attributes.name: helpsidebarclosed
attributes.description: If enabled, keep the sidebar closed when opening the help patcher. If the help patcher is tabbed then this must be applied to the root patcher of the help file.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hint
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: integercoordinates
attributes.description: Whenis enabled, the position and size of all boxes will be rounded ("snapped") to integer values. This can ensure a consistent user interface appearance at any zoom level.

attributes.name: is_mpe
attributes.description: If enabled, a Max for Live device will receive MPE data from Live.

attributes.name: isolateaudio
attributes.digest: Isolate Start and Stop of Patcher Audio
attributes.description: If enabled, starting or stopping audio in this patcher will not affect the audio in other patcher windows.

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: latency
attributes.description: Defined Latency

attributes.name: lefttoolbarpinned
attributes.description: Controls the display of the left toolbar when a file is opened. If set to "last saved", the toolbar will be shown only if it was visible when the patcher was saved. If set to "pin", the left toolbar will always be visible. If set to "unpin" the toolbar will be invisible until the cursor moves over the left edge of the window.

attributes.name: locked_bgcolor
attributes.description: Sets the patcher background color when the patcher is locked.

attributes.name: minimum_live_version
attributes.digest: Minimum required Live version (Max for Live)
attributes.description: Minimum Live version required by this Max for Live device.

attributes.name: minimum_max_version
attributes.digest: Minimum required Max version (Max for Live)
attributes.description: Minimum Max version required by this Max for Live device.

attributes.name: objectsnaponopen
attributes.description: If enabled, "Snap to Objects" will be on when the patcher is opened

attributes.name: openinpresentation
attributes.description: If enabled, the patcher opens in presentation mode.

attributes.name: openrect
attributes.description: Sets the initial window position (horizontal offset/vertical offset/width/height) for the patcher window. If non-zero, changes to the patcher window's size or position will not be reflected when the file is saved.

attributes.name: oscdefer
attributes.description: Turn this on to output received OSC in the low-priority queue in this patcher.

attributes.name: oscparamenableddefault
attributes.description: Enable / disable OSC for parameters by default.

choices.label: Apply the setting in the global Max preferences.
Enable OSC for parameters by default.
Disable OSC for parameters by default.

attributes.name: oscprefix
attributes.description: Prefix to prepend to all OSC addresses generated by Max. Can be overridden by changing the value in the patcher inspector.

attributes.name: oscprefixmode
attributes.description: The type of prefix to prepend to OSC addresses generated by Max.

choices.label: Apply the setting in the global Max preferences.
Do not add any OSC prefix to addresses generated by Max.
Prepend the name of the patcher to OSC addresses generated by Max.
Prepend a custom prefix to OSC addresses generated by Max.

attributes.name: oscqueryenable
attributes.digest: Enable OSCQuery Server For This Patcher
attributes.description: Enable/Disable OSCQuery for this Patch.

choices.label: Apply the setting in the global Max preferences.
Disable OSCQuery for this patch.

attributes.name: oscreceivemode
attributes.description: Select whether and how this patcher should respond to incoming OSC packets.

choices.label: Apply the setting in the global Max preferences.
Disable the ability to control this patcher remotely by OSC.
Enable the ability to control this patcher by sending OSC over UDP to the port set in the global Max preferences.
Enable the ability to control this patcher by sending OSC over UDP to a custom port.

attributes.name: oscreceivequantize
attributes.description: Output OSC only on the specified time-boundary in this patcher. The quantization can be specified in bars.beats.units, ticks, or note values.

attributes.name: oscreceivethreshold
attributes.description: Time threshold under which only one message may be received for this patcher. Time can be specified in any of the time formats used in Max.

attributes.name: oscreceiveudpport
attributes.description: The default UDP port this patcher will listen to for incoming OSC packets.

attributes.name: oscsendmode
attributes.description: Select whether and how this patcher should send OSC data.

choices.label: Apply the setting in the global Max preferences.
Disable sending OSC data from this patcher.
Enable this patcher to send OSC data over UDP using the address and port set in the global Max preferences.
Enable this patcher to send OSC data over UDP using a custom address and port.

attributes.name: oscsendthreshold
attributes.description: Time threshold under which only one message may be sent for this patcher. Time can be specified in any of the time formats used in Max.

attributes.name: oscsendudpaddr
attributes.description: The UDP address that this patcher will send outgoing OSC packets to.

attributes.name: oscsendudpport
attributes.description: The UDP port that this patcher will send outgoing OSC packets to.

attributes.name: oscuseparamprefix
attributes.description: Prepend /param to OSC addresses that describe parameters.

choices.label: Apply the setting in the global Max preferences.
Do prepend /param to OSC addresses that describe parameters.
Do not prepend /param to OSC addresses that describe parameters.

attributes.name: oscvaluemode
attributes.description: Select the type of value(s) Max should send.

choices.label: Apply the setting in the global Max preferences.
Send only the raw (scaled) value.
Send only the raw (scaled) value and append a /raw suffix to the OSC address.
Send only the normalized [0,1] value if available.
Send only the normalized [0,1] value if available and append a /normalized suffix to the OSC address.
Send both the raw (scaled) and normalized [0,1] values. /raw and /normalized suffixes will be automatically appended to distinguish them.

If set to "pin", the right toolbar will always be visible. If set to "unpin" the toolbar will be invisible until the cursor moves over the right edge of the window.

attributes.name: selectioncolor
attributes.description: Sets the default selection color for objects.

attributes.name: showontab
attributes.description: If set to 1 (parent), the patcher’s title will appear as a tab in its parent patcher. If set to 2 (top-level), the patcher's title will appear as a tab of the top-level patcher. In a top-level patcher this attribute is ignored.

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: stripecolor
attributes.description: Sets the default background color for objects that display lists.

attributes.name: style
attributes.description: Sets theto be applied to the patcher. Styles can be defined and edited using the.

attributes.name: subpatcher_template
attributes.description: Sets the template used when creating an embedded subpatcher with the patcher object or when a patcher is created using the Encapsulate feature. Only the toolbar, style, and editing settings are used by the template; objects are not added to the subpatcher.

attributes.name: syntax_attrargcolor
attributes.description: Overrides the current theme's syntax attribute argument color for this patcher

attributes.name: syntax_attributecolor
attributes.description: Overrides the current theme's syntax attribute name color for this patcher

attributes.name: syntax_objargcolor
attributes.description: Overrides the current theme's syntax object argument color for this patcher

attributes.name: syntax_objectcolor
attributes.description: Overrides the current theme's syntax object name color for this patcher

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Sets searchable tags (separated by spaces) used by the database.

attributes.name: tallnewobj
attributes.description: If enabled, the default object box is slightly taller to make its text easier to read.

attributes.name: textcolor
attributes.description: Sets the default text color for comment objects.

attributes.name: textcolor_inverse
attributes.description: Sets the default text color for objects.

attributes.name: textjustification
attributes.description: Sets the default text justification used for new text objects.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Sets the name shown in the patcher’s title bar.

attributes.name: toolbarvisible
attributes.description: If enabled, the toolbars will be shown when the patcher is opened.

attributes.name: toptoolbarpinned
attributes.description: Controls the display of the top toolbar when a file is opened. If set to "last saved", the toolbar will be shown only if it was visible when the patcher was saved. If set to "pin", the top toolbar will always be visible. If set to "unpin" the toolbar will be invisible until the cursor moves over the top edge of the window.

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: workspacedisabled
attributes.description: If enabled, the patcher will not be re-opened when relaunching if it was open when last quitting Max.
